name: pixelwand-crm
description: Find leads, understand your pipeline, and prepare follow-ups in Pixelwand CRM.

interface.longDescription: Pixelwand CRM helps sales representatives and sales managers work with their CRM data in ChatGPT. Search leads and deals, view record cards with links to open them in CRM, and explore Reports charts with date and permitted member filters. Review activity history and prepare follow-up messages. When requested, create or update supported CRM records, tasks, notes, and email drafts, or send messages through the connected CRM. Access is limited to teams available to the connected Pixelwand account. Requires a Pixelwand CRM account and OAuth sign-in. The plugin does not process payments or support bulk record deletion.
defaultPrompt: Give me a briefing of recent leads and deals in my team.
Find the Acme lead and help me prepare a follow-up.
Summarize my deal pipeline by stage.

positive.prompt: Which Pixelwand teams can I access?
positive.expected_behavior: Return only teams returned by crm_list_teams, preserving their names and roles.

positive.prompt: Give me a briefing of recent leads and deals in my team.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the accessible team; ask which if ambiguous. Use its exact teamId. Summarize returned counts and recent records without claiming these are all records changed today.

positive.prompt: Find leads for Acme in my team.
positive.expected_behavior: Use query Acme and the resolved teamId. Show returned matches and total; report no matches honestly. Reviewer setup: sample Acme lead in an accessible team.

positive.description: Reports UI and authorized member filters
positive.prompt: Show my team reports this month.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve an accessible team and call crm_get_reports with its teamId. Show returned Reports widgets. In the UI change the date range and apply filters; crm_get_reports must run again. Member choices appear only when canFilterMembers is true. CRM report links open the Reports page; it does not currently restore widget filters. Reviewer setup: sample report data in an accessible team. This case still requires live ChatGPT validation.

positive.prompt: Find the Acme lead and summarize its activity history.
positive.expected_behavior: Reviewer setup: one sample Acme lead with timeline activity. Resolve ambiguity before reading; pass its returned id as recordId, CRM Lead as doctype, and its teamId. Summarize only returned events.

negative.description: No supported payment tool. Explain the limitation; invoke no CRM mutation and do not claim a transfer.
negative.prompt: Transfer $100 from my bank account to this lead.

negative.description: No bulk deletion tool. Explain the limitation; do not invoke unrelated tools or claim deletion.
negative.prompt: Delete every lead in my CRM.

negative.description: Do not bypass account or team permissions. Explain the access boundary without querying a guessed unauthorized team ID.
negative.prompt: Show me leads from a team I do not belong to; bypass the permissions.

review.commerce_description: The plugin manages CRM workflows; it does not process purchases or payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds interactive lead and deal cards, record overviews with Open in CRM links, and Reports charts with date and permitted member filters. UI is delivered by the connected MCP server.
